boolean_backend_source_evidence.verification: installed Python source inspection; enormous arrays deliberately not allocated

boolean_path.dtype: int32 for this bounded corpus; installed scipy.ndimage.label selects intp when input.size >=2**31-2. The enormous-size branch is source-inspected, not allocated or numerically tested here.
boolean_path.background: Only background==1 inverts input; all other values retain False background.
boolean_path.rank: positive-rank N-D arrays supported, including tested4D and5D; scalar rank0 fails connectivity validation.

non_boolean_path.input_conversion: NumPy signed native index-width integer conversion; fractional floats truncate, full-width unsigned values wrap to signed native index width.
non_boolean_path.background: None means0; other numeric scalar backgrounds convert to signed native index-width integers, including truncating finite fractional values. String, NaN, infinity and out-of-range backgrounds have distinct errors.

contracts.numbering: Components are numbered from1 in order of first logical C-order occurrence; background is0; equal-valued neighbors connect, not all nonzero values.
contracts.connectivity: None selects image.ndim; original scalar is range-validated before its effective orthogonal-hop connectivity. Errors preserve input-rank-specific messages.
contracts.return_num: Default returns ndarray; truthy return_num returns (labels,Python int count); array truth ambiguity errors are preserved.
contracts.ownership: Output is newly owned writable C-order ndarray, with logical shape and no source alias; empty dimensions retain NumPy zero strides.
contracts.workers: Global caps1 and4 must produce the same exact canonical labels/counts; large stripe/checkerboard cases cross256K pixels.
contracts.observed_validation_precedence: Non-bool image casts can warn before rank rejection; rank errors precede background parsing, and background parsing precedes connectivity errors. Bool background comparison/inversion precedes connectivity validation. Collision cases are executable, not inferred from signatures.

evidence_matrix.scope: Half/F32/F64 truncation, signed zero, nonfinite and out-of-range values
int64/uint64 andlonglong aliases; values across2**63; background overflows
large stripes/checkerboard, output labels exceeding16bits, workers1/4
nonzero bool storage bytes1,2,128,255; default andinverted background
both APIs reject upstream dispatch without warning or forwarding
six colliding failures: nonfinite cast/rank/background/connectivity, bool scalar, array-background truth ambiguity

native_interface_proposal.kernel: A stride/endian-aware typed input normalization/conversion pass feeding a union-find orrun-based same-value component scan; separate boolean foreground semantics.
native_interface_proposal.serial: Validate observed metadata/error order, normalize to signed intptr for nonbool andlogical foreground forbool, process backward neighbors for requested L1-hop connectivity, then compact roots by first logical C-order occurrence.
native_interface_proposal.parallel: Partition into independent row/slab tiles under the optional global worker cap; union equal-valued boundary neighbors; compact final roots in global first-occurrence order to preserve exact numbering.
native_interface_proposal.simd: Use SIMD for typed/endian/half-to-index preparation, foreground/equal-value masks or run detection, and final dense root-to-label remapping. Union dependencies remain scalar where needed.
native_interface_proposal.output: Template internal index width separately from public output type; bool small-image outputint32, nonbool outputintp; supportlabel counts>65535; report cast invalid flags for wrapper warning/error policy.
native_interface_proposal.metadata_order: Preserve tested non-bool cast warning/raise before rank error, then background conversion before connectivity validation; bool background==1 comparison/inversion occurs before connectivity validation.

remaining_gaps: Native implementations and dedicated one-thread isolated benchmarks do not exist yet.
This bounded corpus does not prove every array protocol, every high-rank boolean neighborhood, or the source-inspected enormous input-size branch that promotes boolean output to intp.
Complex/object/string inputs, custom scalar comparison protocols and advanced NumPy error callback modes need additional contract packets.
Parallel union boundaries and SIMD variants require independent native goldens and sanitizer checks once a kernel is implemented.
